description: Compute Singapore Seller's Stamp Duty (SSD, in SGD) from the sale price or value and how long the residential property has been held. For net cash from a sale, use `calculate_sales_proceeds`.

price.description: Sale price or market value (whichever higher), in SGD.

purchaseDate.description: Date the property was acquired (ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD).

saleDate.description: Date the property is/was sold (ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD).

name: calculate_seller_stamp_duty

ssd.description: Seller's Stamp Duty payable, in SGD (0 past the holding period).

ssdRate.description: Seller's Stamp Duty rate applied, as a decimal fraction (0.12 = 12%).

title: Seller's Stamp Duty (SSD)
